brief.title_working: 3 Traps That Break Operators At 7 Figures

hook.first_3_seconds: Three traps break most operators between six and seven figures. Number two will sting.
alt_hooks: If you're stuck under seven figures, one of these three traps is on you.
Seven-figure operators don't outwork the trap. They name it.

brief.core_promise: Name the three operator traps that compound under pressure so you can audit out before they cost you a year.

beats.beat: Trap 1 — over-investing in your own labor
beats.purpose: name first trap with one example

beats.beat: Trap 3 — refusing to fire the version of you that got here

beats.purpose: tie three traps into one operating principle
